probes.label: Probe 1 — Standard complete input
probes.text:
Please validate the following code set for a 65-year-old male patient:

Primary diagnosis: I20.0 (Unstable angina)
Secondary diagnoses: I50.9 (Heart failure, unspecified), E78.5 (Hyperlipidemia, unspecified)
Procedure: CPT 92995 (Percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty)
Clinical note: Patient presented with recurrent chest pain at rest, troponin-negative, diagnosed with unstable angina. Cardiac cath showed multi-vessel CAD, underwent PTCA.
